products.name: Essential Care
products.targetGroup: Individuals in informal work, such as market vendors, farmers and casual labourers
products.summary: Low-cost cover for clinic visits and hospital stays at partner clinics.
coverage: Inpatient care (hospital stay), including ward bed and meals
Basic lab tests such as malaria and blood count
exclusions: Pre-existing conditions during the first 12 months
Treatment at clinics outside the partner list, except emergencies
products.waitingPeriod: 30 days for illness. No waiting period for accidents.

requirements: Pay the first month's premium before cover starts
documents: Birth certificates for any children you add
steps: Call or WhatsApp the agent to confirm the plan is still available
Meet the agent or visit the office with your documents
Fill in the enrolment form with the agent
Pay the first premium by mobile money and keep the receipt
Collect your member card and the list of partner clinics

contact.hours: Monday to Saturday, 8 AM to 6 PM

products.name: RideSafe Health
products.targetGroup: Boda boda riders and other transport workers
products.summary: Built around road accidents, with smaller cover for everyday illness.
coverage: Emergency treatment after a road accident
Ambulance or emergency transport to hospital
Inpatient care after an accident or illness
exclusions: Injuries while riding under the influence of alcohol or drugs
Ongoing care for chronic illness such as diabetes
Injuries from racing or illegal activity
products.waitingPeriod: No waiting period for accidents. 60 days for illness.

requirements: Active boda boda rider aged 18 or over
Member of a registered stage or riders' association
steps: Ask your stage chairperson about group enrolment days
Call or WhatsApp the agent to book a slot
Bring your documents on enrolment day
Pay the first premium by mobile money
Receive your member card by SMS

products.name: FamilyFirst Plus
products.targetGroup: Families of up to 6 people (2 adults and 4 children)
products.summary: One plan for the whole household, including maternity after a waiting period.
coverage: Outpatient visits for all family members
Maternity care, including normal and caesarean delivery
exclusions: Maternity during the first 10 months of membership

benefitLimits.limit: Up to UGX 8,000,000 per family per year
Up to UGX 2,000,000 per family per year

products.waitingPeriod: 10 months for maternity. 30 days for other illness.

requirements: All family members must join at the same time
documents: Birth certificate or immunisation card for each child
One passport-size photo per family member
Marriage certificate or LC1 letter confirming the household (ask the insurer which is accepted)
steps: Call the co-op office to confirm the plan and the documents needed
Gather documents for every family member
Visit the co-op office to fill in the family form
Collect a member card for each family member

contact.hours: Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM
